comment: What db/kernels.json records. `files`: the kernel-mode files. `windows`: the Windows versions whose x64 files are taken from the Microsoft symbol server, each named as Winbindex names it (`winbindex`, a name or a list of names), the newest build under those names; Windows 10 21H2 and 22H2 share one kernel, build 19045, and Winbindex files its newer updates under 21H2. `wdkLibraries`: WDK packages whose import libraries are read, for the files' exports on an arch the symbol server's index does not cover: WDK 10.0.22621 is the last with x86 kernel-mode libraries, its bundle read as data (never run) and only the named package fetched. twinBASIC builds no arm64 code, so there is none.
